<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Functional\Api;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Test\WebTestCase;

use function json_encode;

final class __API_TEST_CLASS__ extends WebTestCase
{
  #[Test]
  public function test__SUCCESS_TEST_NAME__(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request(
      method: '__HTTP_METHOD__',
      uri: '__URI__',
      server: ['CONTENT_TYPE' => 'application/json'],
      content: (string) json_encode(__PAYLOAD__),
    );

    self::assertSame(__EXPECTED_STATUS_CODE__, $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode());
    __SUCCESS_RESPONSE_ASSERTIONS__
  }

  #[Test]
  public function test__FAILURE_TEST_NAME__(): void
  {
    $client = static::createClient();

    $client->request('__FAILURE_HTTP_METHOD__', '__FAILURE_URI__');

    self::assertContains(
      needle: $client->getResponse()->getStatusCode(),
      haystack: [401, 403, 404, 409, 422],
    );
  }
}
